in_sanskrit.name: सत्विक
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Satvik is derived from the Sanskrit word Satva, which means truth, goodness, or purity. The name Satvik itself means 'possessing the quality of Satva', or 'pure, truthful, and good'.

in_hindi.name: सत्विक
in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, the name Satvik is translated as 'सत्तावेश', which means 'possessing the quality of Satva', or 'pure, truthful, and good'.

in_tamil.name: சத்விக்
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, the name Satvik is translated as 'சத்விக்', which means 'ஆத்மகுலத்தின் அவ்வீர்க்குள் சத்தமானவர்', which means 'one who has the quality of truth, purity, and goodness within their soul'.

in_telugu.name: శద్ధదేశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: In Telugu, the name Satvik is translated as 'శద్దదేశ', which means 'శద్దశయేదియేశ్య', which means 'one who possesses pure, truthful, and good qualities'

in_marathi.name: Satvik
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Truthful, Pure, Good
in_marathi.long_meaning: Satvik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Satvik comes from the Sanskrit word 'Satva', which means truth or goodness. It is one of the three gunas, or fundamental qualities of the universe, and represents purity, truth, and knowledge. A satvik person is one who is pure, truthful, and possesses wisdom and knowledge.
